messages:
Neha Iyer: FYI since ~05:15 UTC we've observed delayed tenant activations for Private deployments. Symptoms: onboarding callbacks queued, some trials not marked 'active'. I pulled ~9 affected tenants. Need a short customer status + replay/renewal plan. @Caleb can you draft a note?

Caleb Ortiz: Draft below. Keep it concise and action-oriented.

Caleb Ortiz: Hi <Customer> — we	detected a delay in onboarding activations for Private deployments caused by a provisioning queue regression. We applied a fix and expect most activations to complete within 1	3 hours. If you need a manual replay sooner, reply here or email cs@redwood.com and we will prioritize you. We will follow up with an RCA and credits if impact meets SLA. — Redwood CS

Ruth Kim: Tone is good. Add a sentence for renewal owners: "We will flag tenants with activation >48h as renewal-monitor and provide tailored outreach."

Caleb Ortiz: Added renewal-monitor line and an office-hours link.

Sam Holden: Tech note: root cause is a regression in the private-provisioner that caused worker allocation to stall under burst provisioning patterns (merged in rollout-2026-03-21). I pushed a rollback and increased the allocation timeout. On-demand scale triggered; worker count rising now.

DevOps-Bot: [action] rollback/private-provisioner deployed by Sam Holden 	7: job 4421 	replicas 8 -> 20

Neha Iyer: ETA for backlog clear and any risk to customer data?

Sam Holden: Backlog drain ETA ~2060min depending on tenant queue. No data loss; jobs are durable and reentrant. Prioritizing tenants marked high-touch.

Ruth Kim: I'll schedule office hours at 08:30 UTC and create KB note with manual replay steps and a short FAQ. Who can join for live replays? Sam, can you attend?

Sam Holden: Yes 08:3009:30 UTC. Will bring traces + telemetry.

Caleb Ortiz: Sending first customer batch now. Message I'll post: ```Hi there 	we detected delayed activations for your Private deployment due to a provisioning issue. We	applied a fix and expect activations to finish within 1	3 hours. If you	need an expedited manual replay, reply here or email cs@redwood.com. We will follow up with a technical RCA and proposed credits if applicable. 										Neha, Redwood CS```

Ruth Kim: Manual replay snippet for KB:```
POST /internal/replay/v1/tenants/{tenant_id} -H "Authorization: Bearer $CS_TOKEN"
kubectl -n vpc-{tenant} logs -f replay-worker-{pod}
SELECT * FROM webhook.events WHERE tenant_id={tenant_id} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;
```

Neha Iyer: Renewal play: mark any tenant with activation >48h as "renewal-monitor" and trigger personalized outreach. Caleb please add CRM flags and link to office hours.

Caleb Ortiz: CRM notes updated and office-hours link included. Also adding a one-question feedback survey to follow-up.

DevOps-Bot: [notice] replay jobs queued: 9 tenants.

Sam Holden: Replays in progress, first tenants confirming callbacks delivered. I'll post E2E latency graphs in the RCA doc later today.

Neha Iyer: Actions: Caleb send batches & CRM flags (in progress), Ruth KB + office hours + feedback doc (in progress), Sam full RCA + telemetry (ETA EOD). I'll assemble exec summary and renewal-risk queue. Add your action items here.
